change: 30 older-adult and family-carer situation contexts clarified as editorial hypotheses; identities, titles, statuses, links, evidence and media preserved.

updates.title: An online booking system prevents me from arranging care myself
updates.before: An older person facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: Arranging care depends on a digital process the person cannot complete independently.

updates.title: After my relative dies, I lose both the caring role and the support built around it
updates.before: A family caregiver facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: Bereavement also ends daily caring routines and contact with people or services organised around that role.

updates.title: The home-care visit is too short for the help my relative needs that day
updates.before: A family caregiver facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The planned visit ends before the relative has received all the help needed on that particular day.

updates.title: Paid home support is unavailable during the hours I cannot be there
updates.before: A family caregiver facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The family member’s unavailable hours do not overlap with the home support they can obtain.

updates.title: A hospital admission leaves my pet without someone to care for it
updates.before: An older person facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: An unplanned stay away from home interrupts the pet’s usual feeding and care arrangements.

updates.title: I am unsure which mobility aid fits my home and daily life
updates.before: An older person facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The person needs to judge an aid against their actual rooms, routes and everyday activities.

updates.title: I need help reading private letters without giving up my privacy
updates.before: An older person facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: Reading support requires access to personal correspondence the person wants to keep confidential.

updates.title: Nobody notices when I have barely drunk anything all day
updates.before: An older person facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: A low intake goes unnoticed because there is no shared picture of what the person has had to drink.

updates.title: My relative's needs have changed in hospital and our previous routine no longer works
updates.before: A family caregiver facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The arrangements made before admission no longer fit the relative’s abilities and support needs afterward.

updates.title: Written care instructions are not available in a language I can read
updates.before: An older person facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The person cannot use the written instructions independently because the available language is unfamiliar.

updates.title: I cannot explain my wishes when urgent treatment decisions arise
updates.before: An older person facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: A time-sensitive decision arises when the person cannot communicate what matters to them.

updates.title: Helping my relative eat takes longer than the support I can arrange
updates.before: A family caregiver facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The relative needs more time and assistance at meals than the family member can secure.

updates.title: I notice a change but staff and I have no agreed way to share concerns
updates.before: A family caregiver facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The family member has observations to contribute but no clear channel or expectation for follow-up.

updates.title: Professionals discuss my care with relatives instead of with me
updates.before: An older person facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The person is present or affected but conversations about their care bypass their own voice.

updates.title: Changes to the care schedule reach me too late to adjust my own plans
updates.before: A family caregiver facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: Late notice of care changes leaves the family member little time to rearrange work or other commitments.

updates.title: I want companionship without feeling pushed to replace the person I lost
updates.before: An older person facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The person wants connection that allows space for bereavement and the relationship they still value.

updates.title: I want regular company rather than a different visitor every time
updates.before: An older person facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: Repeated introductions make it harder to build the familiar relationship the person wants.

updates.title: My relative has fallen but insists nothing is wrong
updates.before: A family caregiver facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The family member is concerned after a fall while the relative does not share that concern.

updates.title: I want to keep familiar daily rituals in an unfamiliar home
updates.before: An older person facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: Moving has disrupted small routines that help the person feel settled and recognise everyday life.

updates.title: Getting my relative to the appointment takes more help than I can arrange
updates.before: A family caregiver facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The journey requires assistance that goes beyond simply booking transport or an appointment.

updates.title: I have little privacy when a partner or friend visits my care home
updates.before: An older person facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The person cannot easily spend time alone with a visitor in the available space and visiting arrangements.

updates.title: I have to help my relative wash but neither of us is comfortable with the arrangement
updates.before: A family caregiver facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: Personal washing crosses boundaries that the relative and family member find difficult to negotiate.

updates.title: I forget appointments or lose track of the day
updates.before: An older person facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The person loses track of scheduled events and needs a way to orient themselves during the day.

updates.title: I cannot find continued recovery support after the initial programme ends
updates.before: A family caregiver facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The initial support stops while the relative still needs help to continue their recovery.

updates.title: My recovery appointments are spread across places I cannot easily reach
updates.before: An older person facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: Following the recovery plan requires journeys between locations that are difficult for the person to manage.

updates.title: I repeat my relative's history whenever a new professional gets involved
updates.before: A family caregiver facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: Each new professional starts without enough shared history, leaving the family member to recount it.

updates.title: A different visiting carer arrives each time and I have to explain the routine again
updates.before: A family caregiver facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: Changes in visiting staff leave the family member explaining preferences and daily arrangements repeatedly.

updates.title: I become ill and there is no one ready to take over the next care tasks
updates.before: A family caregiver facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The usual carer cannot provide support and no substitute has the information or arrangements to begin.

updates.title: I am worried about being unable to get up at night
updates.before: An older person facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: Night-time movement feels uncertain, especially when the person does not know what help will be available.

updates.title: I want help without someone monitoring everything I do
updates.before: An older person facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The person wants practical assistance while retaining control over which activities and information are observed.
